sites.name: Acropolis and Parthenon
sites.access: Steep marble paths, slippery. A lift on the north side serves wheelchair users. Timed tickets online; book days ahead in summer. Combined ticket covers the Agora and other sites.

sites.name: Areopagus (Mars Hill)
sites.access: The old marble steps are very slippery; use the metal stairs beside them. Free.

sites.name: Acropolis Museum
sites.access: Fully step-free with lifts. Buy online to skip the line.

sites.name: Ancient Agora
sites.access: Gravel paths and slopes. Included in the combined ticket.

sites.name: Plaka and Anafiotika
sites.access: Anafiotika is steep with many steps. Free.

sites.name: Syntagma Square and the changing of the guard
sites.access: Flat and step-free. Free.

sites.name: Athens Cathedral and the Little Metropolis
sites.access: A few steps at the entrance. Free. Cover shoulders and knees.

sites.name: Monastiraki and the flea market
sites.access: Flat, crowded streets. Free.

sites.name: Temple of Olympian Zeus and Hadrian's Arch
sites.access: Flat gravel. Combined ticket or single entry.

sites.name: Lycabettus Hill
sites.access: Funicular, then a few steps. Funicular round trip about €10.

sites.name: Theatre of Dionysus
sites.access: Uneven stone and steps; the lower rows are easiest. Included in the Acropolis ticket; enter at the south-slope gate near the Acropolis Museum.

sites.name: Acropolis promenade (Dionysiou Areopagitou and Apostolou Pavlou)
sites.access: Wide, smooth paving; one of the easiest walks in central Athens. Some marble sections are slippery when wet. Free.

sites.name: Agia Ekaterini (St Catherine's Church)
sites.access: Steps down to the courtyard. Free. Dress modestly: shoulders and knees covered.

sites.name: Panagia Kapnikarea
sites.access: Level street; a small step at the door. Free. Dress modestly.

sites.name: Roman Agora and Tower of the Winds
sites.access: Mostly level gravel and paving. Included in the combined Acropolis-area ticket, or buy a single ticket at the gate.

sites.name: National Archaeological Museum
sites.access: Fully accessible, with lifts. Buy online or at the door; lines are rarely long.

sites.name: Byzantine and Christian Museum
sites.access: Mostly accessible; galleries are underground with ramps and lifts. Buy at the door; rarely a line.

sites.name: National Garden
sites.access: Flat gravel paths, easy for wheelchairs and strollers. Free.

sites.name: Philopappos Hill
sites.access: Steep in places, on uneven stone paths. Wear good shoes. Free.

farther.name: Ancient Corinth
farther.travelNote: About 1 hour 15 minutes each way by car or tour; stop at the Corinth Canal on the way.
farther.access: Uneven ancient paving. Site and museum about €8.

farther.name: Temple of Poseidon at Sounion
farther.travelNote: About 1 hour 15 minutes each way along the coast road.

farther.name: Delphi
farther.travelNote: About 2 hours 30 minutes each way by car or tour: a full day.
farther.access: Steep climb to the stadium. About €20 for site and museum.

farther.name: Corinth Canal
farther.travelNote: About 1 hour west of Athens by car or tour coach on the highway; trains run to Corinth, then a short taxi.
farther.access: Level pavement on the viewing bridge. Free to view from the bridge.

farther.name: Acrocorinth
farther.travelNote: A 10-minute drive up from Ancient Corinth (about 1 hour 20 minutes from Athens); taxis wait at Ancient Corinth.
farther.access: Steep, rough, slippery paths. Not suitable for limited mobility. Wear good shoes and bring water. Usually free.

sites.name: Palace of Knossos
sites.access: Mostly flat paths with some steps; little shade. Book online; combined ticket with the museum available.

sites.name: Heraklion Archaeological Museum
sites.access: Step-free with lifts. About €12; combined ticket with Knossos.

sites.name: Venetian harbor and Koules fortress
sites.access: Ramps inside; the roof has steps. About €4.

sites.name: Lions Square and 25th August Street
sites.access: Flat, pedestrian streets. Free.

sites.name: Church of Saint Titus
sites.access: Step-free. Free. Cover shoulders and knees.

sites.name: Agios Minas Cathedral
sites.access: A few steps. Free.

sites.name: 1866 Street market
sites.access: Flat. Free.

farther.name: Phaistos palace
farther.travelNote: About 1 hour 15 minutes each way by car.

farther.name: Kali Limenes (Fair Havens)
farther.travelNote: About 1 hour 45 minutes each way on mountain roads.

restaurants.id: herb s garden lato hotel roof
restaurants.name: Herb's Garden (Lato Hotel roof)

sites.name: Ancient Ephesus
sites.access: Long walk on uneven marble, little shade. Bring water and a hat. About €40; the Terrace Houses are extra and worth it.

sites.name: Basilica of Saint John
sites.access: Mostly flat with some uneven ground. About €8.

sites.name: House of the Virgin Mary
sites.access: Gentle paths; some slopes. About €15.

sites.name: Temple of Artemis
sites.access: Flat. Free.

sites.name: Pigeon Island castle
sites.access: Flat causeway. Free.

sites.name: Fira caldera path
sites.access: Many steps and narrow paths. Free.

sites.name: Oia village
sites.access: Marble lanes and many steps. Free.

sites.name: Akrotiri prehistoric town
sites.access: Walkways with ramps. About €20.

sites.name: Pyrgos village
sites.access: Steep lanes and steps. Free.

sites.name: Museum of Prehistoric Thera
sites.access: Step-free. About €10.

sites.name: Mykonos Town (Chora) lanes
sites.access: Narrow, uneven lanes with steps. Free.

sites.name: Kato Mili windmills
sites.access: A short uphill path. Free.

sites.name: Little Venice
sites.access: Narrow lanes. Free.

sites.name: Panagia Paraportiani church
sites.access: Flat. Free.

farther.name: Delos island
farther.travelNote: About 30 to 40 minutes each way by boat from the old harbor. Boats leave from about 9:00.
farther.access: Rough ground and no shade. Bring water and a hat. Boat about €25, site about €15.

sites.name: Venetian harbor and lighthouse
sites.access: Flat quay; the breakwater is uneven. Free.

sites.name: Old town lanes and Topanas
sites.access: Cobbled lanes, some steps. Free.

sites.name: Municipal Market (Agora)
sites.access: Step-free. Free.

sites.name: Church of Saint Nicholas, Splantzia
sites.access: Step-free. Free.

sites.name: Firkas fortress and Maritime Museum
sites.access: Some steps. About €4.

farther.name: Balos lagoon
farther.travelNote: About 1 hour 30 minutes by car and a hike, or by boat from Kissamos. Tight on a port day.

farther.name: Souda Bay War Cemetery
farther.travelNote: Right by the cruise port: 5 minutes by taxi.

sites.name: Messina Cathedral and the astronomical clock
sites.access: Step-free into the cathedral. Cathedral free; small fee to climb the bell tower.

sites.name: Santissima Annunziata dei Catalani
sites.access: Steps down. Free.

sites.name: Regional Museum of Messina
sites.access: Step-free. About €8.

farther.name: Taormina
farther.travelNote: About 1 hour each way by car, tour or train plus shuttle.

farther.name: Reggio Calabria (ancient Rhegium)
farther.travelNote: About 30 minutes each way by fast ferry across the strait.

sites.name: Spaccanapoli and the historic center
sites.access: Cobbles, scooters and narrow pavements. Free.

sites.name: Sansevero Chapel (Veiled Christ)
sites.access: Step-free main chapel; stairs to the crypt. Timed tickets online; small chapel, sells out.

sites.name: Naples Cathedral and the Chapel of San Gennaro
sites.access: Step-free. Free; small fee for the baptistery.

sites.name: Piazza del Plebiscito and the Royal Palace
sites.access: Flat. Square free; palace about €15.

sites.name: National Archaeological Museum
sites.access: Step-free. About €22.

farther.name: Pompeii
farther.travelNote: About 40 minutes each way by Circumvesuviana train from Napoli Centrale, or by car.
farther.access: Rough stone streets, little shade. About €22; book online.

farther.name: Capri
farther.travelNote: About 50 minutes each way by fast ferry from Molo Beverello, right next to the cruise terminal.
farther.access: Ferry about €25 each way; Blue Grotto boat extra.

farther.name: Sorrento
farther.travelNote: About 40 minutes each way by ferry, or 1 hour on the Circumvesuviana train.

farther.name: Pozzuoli (ancient Puteoli)
farther.travelNote: About 30 minutes each way by metro line 2 or taxi.

sites.name: St Peter's Basilica
sites.access: Step-free basilica; the dome is 320+ steps after the lift. Free; dome climb about €10. Security line can be long. Cover shoulders and knees.

sites.name: Colosseum and Roman Forum
sites.access: Lift to the Colosseum upper level; the Forum is uneven. Timed tickets online only, released 30 days ahead. Combined with the Forum and Palatine.

sites.name: Pantheon
sites.access: Step-free. About €5.

sites.name: Trevi Fountain
sites.access: Steps down to the basin. Free (a small entry fee for the basin area is planned).

sites.name: Piazza Navona
sites.access: Flat. Free.

farther.name: Basilica of Saint Paul Outside the Walls
farther.travelNote: About 20 minutes by metro line B from the Colosseum.

sites.name: Sagrada Família
sites.access: Step-free in the basilica; towers are stairs and a lift. Timed tickets only, sold online and often gone days ahead. Book the tower add-on early.

sites.name: Park Güell
sites.access: Steep hills and steps. Arrive by taxi at the upper gate for less climbing. Timed entry to the monumental zone; book online. The rest of the park is free.

sites.name: Casa Batlló
sites.access: Lift to most floors. Book online to skip the ticket line; the 'Gold' ticket skips the entry queue too.

sites.name: Casa Milà (La Pedrera)
sites.access: Lift to the attic; the roof has steps. Book online. Night visits with a light show are a calmer option.

sites.name: Gothic Quarter & Cathedral
sites.access: Cobbles and narrow lanes; the cathedral is step-free. A visitor fee covers the cathedral, cloister and roof. Shoulders and knees covered.

sites.name: La Rambla & La Boqueria market
sites.access: Flat and step-free. Free.

sites.name: Museu Picasso
sites.access: Step-free with lifts. Timed tickets online. Free Thursday evenings and the first Sunday of the month (book ahead).

sites.name: Santa Maria del Mar
sites.access: Step-free. Free at worship times; a small fee for visitors and rooftop tours.

sites.name: Palau de la Música Catalana
sites.access: Lift available; ask at the desk. Tours only, in English several times a day; book ahead. A concert is the best way to see it.

sites.name: Sant Pau Recinte Modernista
sites.access: Mostly step-free with ramps. Buy at the door or online.

sites.name: Bunkers del Carmel
sites.access: Steep climb from the bus stop. Not suitable for wheelchairs. Free.

sites.name: Gràcia squares
sites.access: Flat streets. Free.

sites.name: Mercat de Sant Antoni
sites.access: Step-free. Free.

sites.name: Parc de la Ciutadella
sites.access: Flat paths. Free.

sites.name: Barceloneta beach
sites.access: Boardwalk is flat; beach access ramps in places. Free.

sites.name: Montjuïc Castle
sites.access: Cable car is step-free; castle has slopes and steps. Castle ticket plus the cable car; buy the cable car online to skip its line.

sites.name: MNAC & Magic Fountain
sites.access: Escalators and lifts up from Plaça d'Espanya. Ticket valid two days. Free Saturday afternoons.

sites.name: El Born Centre de Cultura
sites.access: Step-free walkway. Main hall is free.

farther.name: Montserrat monastery
farther.travelNote: About 1 hour each way: train from Plaça d'Espanya, then the rack railway or cable car up the mountain.
farther.access: Rack railway is step-free; the monastery has slopes. Combined train and rack-railway tickets at Plaça d'Espanya. Choir times vary.

farther.name: Sitges
farther.travelNote: About 40 minutes each way by train from Passeig de Gràcia or Sants.
farther.access: Regular commuter train, no booking needed.

farther.name: Girona old town
farther.travelNote: About 40 minutes each way by high-speed train from Sants.
farther.access: Book the high-speed train a few days ahead for the best fares.

farther.name: Tibidabo
farther.travelNote: About 40 minutes each way: train or bus to the base, then the Cuca de Llum funicular.
farther.access: The amusement park keeps limited days outside summer; check the calendar.

sites.name: Prado Museum
sites.access: Step-free with lifts. Book online. Free the last two hours of each day (long line).

sites.name: Royal Palace
sites.access: Mostly step-free. Book online; free for EU residents some evenings.

sites.name: Plaza Mayor and Puerta del Sol
sites.access: Flat. Free.

sites.name: Retiro Park
sites.access: Flat paths. Free; boats about €6.

sites.name: Reina Sofía Museum (Guernica)
sites.access: Step-free. About €12; free some evenings.

sites.name: Chocolatería San Ginés
sites.access: Step-free. About €6.

sites.name: Almudena Cathedral
sites.access: Step-free. Free; small fee for the dome museum.

farther.name: Toledo
farther.travelNote: About 35 minutes each way by high-speed train from Atocha.

farther.name: El Escorial monastery
farther.travelNote: About 1 hour each way by commuter train or bus.

point.name: Athens Airport (Eleftherios Venizelos)
point.startNote: About 40 minutes to the center by taxi (fixed fare by day), or metro line 3.

point.startNote: About 40 minutes to the center by taxi (fixed fare by day), or metro line 3.

point.name: Piraeus cruise terminals
point.startNote: About 30 to 40 minutes to the Acropolis by taxi, or take metro line 1 or 3 from Piraeus station.

point.name: Kusadasi cruise port
point.startNote: Ephesus is about 20 minutes by taxi or tour bus.

point.name: Mykonos new port (Tourlos)
point.startNote: Sea bus to the old harbor every 20 to 30 minutes, about 10 minutes.

point.name: Souda Bay cruise port
point.startNote: Chania old town is about 20 minutes away by taxi or the shuttle bus.

point.name: Civitavecchia cruise port
point.startNote: Rome is about 1 hour 15 minutes by train from Civitavecchia station, or 1.5 hours by car. Leave Rome by mid-afternoon.

point.name: Moll Adossat cruise terminals
point.startNote: Most big ships dock here. A port shuttle bus runs to the Columbus Monument.

point.name: Madrid-Barajas Airport, Terminal 4
point.startNote: About 25 minutes to the center by taxi (flat fare), or the airport express bus.

point.name: Madrid-Barajas Airport, Terminal 4
point.startNote: About 25 minutes to the center by taxi (flat fare), or the airport express bus.
